from fixtures import load_fixtures, ROWS
from digest import FixtureSummary

MEAN = sum(v for _, v in ROWS) / len(ROWS)


def test_mean_of_stored():
    assert abs(FixtureSummary(load_fixtures()).mean_goals() - MEAN) < 1e-9


def test_count_of_list():
    assert FixtureSummary(list(load_fixtures())).count() == len(ROWS)
